description: Create the complete Operation Maaf Karo 1/5 Footiya website with all screens, flows, animations, and interactions as a single-page application using pure HTML/CSS/JS with glassmorphism design, animated gradients, floating stars, clouds, sparkles, and confetti.
steps: Create images/ directory with placeholder support for final-meme.jpg, final-meme.gif, celebration.gif, and memory1-5.jpg

Create index.html with: CSP meta tag, semantic HTML structure, all screen containers (fingerprint scanner, loading, anger detection, main apology, yes-flow levels, no-flow, advanced protocol, heartbreak, celebration, shayari, final record, meme, memory gallery), link to style.css, script tag for script.js, no inline JavaScript

Create style.css with: CSS custom properties for theming, animated gradient backgrounds, glassmorphism card styles (backdrop-filter, blur, transparency), floating star animations (@keyframes), cloud animations, sparkle effects, confetti animations, fingerprint scanner animation (pulsing/scanning effect), progress bar styles with color transitions (green/yellow/orange/red), anger meter styling, button styles (YES green glow, NO red), NO button escape animation (transform/transition for desktop hover and mobile touch), responsive breakpoints for mobile/tablet/desktop, card flip/slide transitions between screens, portal animation keyframes, celebration screen particle effects, shayari card styles, memory gallery grid layout with captions, loading screen spinner/progress styles

Create script.js with: All logic using addEventListener (no inline JS, no eval). Implement state machine for screen transitions. SCREEN 1: Fingerprint scanner with tap-to-proceed. SCREEN 2: Loading with rotating messages (Detecting 1/5 Footiya, Scanning anger level, Analyzing sibling damage, Searching forgiveness database, Activating Brother Apology Mode, Loading Cute Sister Protocol) then anger display (0.5/5 Footiya green). MAIN APOLOGY: YES/NO buttons. YES FLOW: 10 levels (Thoda sa maaf kiya?, Pakka?, Sach mein?, 100% sure?, No takebacks?, Still sure?, Very sure?, Absolutely sure?, Officially?, Final confirmation?) with random compliment cards between levels. NO FLOW: Anger meter increases (0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5 out of 5) with color changes and random messages. NO BUTTON BEHAVIOR: On desktop, button escapes cursor on mouseover; on mobile, button jumps on touchstart near it. After 12 NO attempts: Advanced Protocol loading then new screen. If YES BHAIYA IS NOT BAD: return to yes flow. If NO BHAIYA IS BAD: heartbreak screen then restart option or portal back to fingerprint. SUCCESS FLOW: After 10 yes confirmations, loading then celebration with confetti/stars. SHAYARI SCREEN: 4 cards displayed. FINAL RECORD: Loading then success display with 100% progress. MEME SCREEN: Load from images/ with fallback. MEMORY GALLERY: Display available images with editable captions using contenteditable.

Implement NO button escape logic: On desktop use mousemove event to detect cursor proximity and translate button away smoothly. On mobile use touchstart/touchmove to detect finger position and reposition button. Ensure button never leaves viewport using getBoundingClientRect checks.

Implement confetti/celebration system: Create particle system with colored confetti pieces using absolutely positioned divs with random rotations, colors, and fall speeds. Trigger on celebration screen and after each YES level completion.

Implement compliment card system: Array of 10+ compliment messages all using exact nickname '1/5 Footiya'. Random selection without repeat until all shown. Display as animated card that fades in, shows for 2 seconds, then transitions to next level.

Add security: CSP meta tag (default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self'), security comments in code, use textContent not innerHTML where possible, no cookies/tracking/analytics/API keys

Glassmorphism styling with animated gradient background
Confetti and celebration animations on success
Final record screen shows 100% progress bar
Meme screen shows image or placeholder
Memory gallery supports images with editable captions
